title: Si tuviera tiempo…: conditional sentences
summary: Real, hypothetical and impossible-past conditions: si tengo… iré, si tuviera… iría, si hubiera sabido… habría venido.
focus: Choosing the right tense in each half of a conditional sentence
content:
## Real conditions: si + present

When the condition is possible or likely, use **si** + present indicative. The result goes in the present, the future or the imperative.

- **Si hace buen tiempo, comemos en la terraza.** (If the weather's good, we eat on the terrace.)
- **Si sales ahora, llegarás a tiempo.** (If you leave now, you'll get there on time.)
- **Si ves a Pablo, dile que me llame.** (If you see Pablo, tell him to call me.)

The si-clause can come first or second: **Te llamo si tengo noticias.** Put a comma only when **si** comes first.

## Hypothetical: si + imperfect subjunctive

For something unlikely, or untrue right now, use **si** + imperfect subjunctive, then the conditional.

- **Si tuviera tiempo, leería más.** (If I had time, I'd read more.)
- **Si fuera tú, no lo haría.** (If I were you, I wouldn't do it.)
- **Si vivierais más cerca, os veríamos más a menudo.** (If you lived closer, we'd see you more often.)

The **-se** form works the same after si: **si tuviese, si fuese**. English uses a past (*if I had*); Spanish needs the subjunctive. **Si fuera tú…** and **yo en tu lugar…** are the classic ways to give advice.

## The impossible past: si hubiera hecho

For a past that can no longer change, use **si** + pluperfect subjunctive: **hubiera** (or **hubiese**) + participle.

| | -ra form | -se form |
|---|---|---|
| yo | hubiera hecho | hubiese hecho |
| tú | hubieras hecho | hubieses hecho |
| él / ella / usted | hubiera hecho | hubiese hecho |
| nosotros/as | hubiéramos hecho | hubiésemos hecho |
| vosotros/as | hubierais hecho | hubieseis hecho |
| ellos / ellas / ustedes | hubieran hecho | hubiesen hecho |

The result takes **habría** + participle, or **hubiera** + participle with the same meaning:

- **Si hubieras venido, te habrías divertido.** (If you had come, you'd have had fun.)
- **Si lo hubiera visto, lo hubiera comprado.** (If I'd seen it, I'd have bought it.)

## Mixed conditions and de + infinitive

A past condition can have its result **now**. Use si + **hubiera** + participle, then the simple conditional.

- **Si hubiera estudiado medicina, ahora sería médica.** (If I had studied medicine, I'd be a doctor now.)
- **Si no hubiéramos perdido el mapa, no estaríamos aquí.** (If we hadn't lost the map, we wouldn't be here.)

In careful speech and writing, **de** + infinitive can replace the si-clause, with **de haber** + participle for the past:

- **De haberlo sabido, habría venido.** (Had I known, I'd have come.)
- **De tener dinero, me compraría una casa.** (If I had money, I'd buy a house.)

## Two things never follow si

After **si** meaning *if*, Spanish never uses:

- the **present subjunctive**: not *si tenga*, but **si tengo** or **si tuviera**;
- the **conditional**: not *si tendría*, but **si tuviera**; not *si habría sabido*, but **si hubiera sabido**.

The conditional belongs in the other half of the sentence. As a quick test, a **-ría** form never comes straight after **si**.

Note that **si** meaning *whether*, in an indirect question, is a different use. **No sé si vendría** (I don't know whether he'd come) is correct.

vocabulary.example: Si no vas a la fiesta, te arrepentirás.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If you don't go to the party, you'll regret it.

vocabulary.meaning: to make the most of, to make good use of
vocabulary.example: Si aprovecharas mejor las mañanas, tendrías la tarde libre.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If you made better use of your mornings, you'd have the afternoon free.

vocabulary.example: Si me atreviera a hablar en público, presentaría yo el proyecto.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If I dared to speak in public, I'd present the project myself.

vocabulary.example: Si no corres ningún riesgo, nunca sabrás si funciona.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If you don't take any risks, you'll never know whether it works.

vocabulary.meaning: to listen to, to take notice of (advice)
vocabulary.example: Si le hubieras hecho caso al médico, ya estarías curado.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If you had listened to the doctor, you'd be better by now.

vocabulary.meaning: to win the lottery (la lotería le toca a alguien)
vocabulary.example: ¿Qué harías si te tocara la lotería?
vocabulary.example_meaning: What would you do if you won the lottery?

vocabulary.example: Si hubiera estudiado un poco más, no habría suspendido física.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If I had studied a bit more, I wouldn't have failed physics.

vocabulary.example: Si consigues la beca, podrás estudiar en Roma.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If you get the scholarship, you'll be able to study in Rome.

vocabulary.meaning: in your place, if I were you
vocabulary.example: Yo, en tu lugar, aceptaría la oferta.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If I were you, I'd accept the offer.

vocabulary.example: Llévate el abrigo; de lo contrario, pasarás frío.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Take your coat; otherwise you'll be cold.

vocabulary.example: Si hubiéramos salido a las seis, a estas alturas ya estaríamos en Valencia.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If we had left at six, we'd already be in Valencia by now.

vocabulary.meaning: had I known, if I had known
vocabulary.example: De haberlo sabido, habría reservado mesa.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Had I known, I'd have booked a table.

vocabulary.meaning: to make a mistake, to be wrong
vocabulary.example: Si me equivoco, corrígeme, por favor.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If I get it wrong, correct me, please.

quiz.prompt: Si me ___ la lotería, dejaría de trabajar y daría la vuelta al mundo.
quiz.explanation: An unlikely condition with a conditional result (dejaría) takes si + imperfect subjunctive: si me tocara.
hints: The result is dejaría: which tense goes after si with it?

quiz.prompt: Si ___ (aprovechar, tú) bien esta semana, aprobarás el examen sin problemas. (If you make good use of this week, you'll pass the exam easily.)
quiz.explanation: A real, likely condition with a future result takes si + present indicative: si aprovechas.

quiz.prompt: Si ves a Lucía, ___ que la beca ya ha llegado.
quiz.explanation: A real condition (si ves) can lead to an imperative: dile que… = tell her that…
hints: Si + present can be followed by a command.

quiz.prompt: Si ___ (saber, yo) que ibas a suspender, te habría ayudado a estudiar. (If I had known you were going to fail, I'd have helped you study.)
quiz.explanation: An impossible past condition takes si + pluperfect subjunctive: hubiera sabido (or hubiese sabido).
hints: The result is habría ayudado: the past can't change.

quiz.prompt: Si me hubieras hecho caso, no te ___ (equivocarse). (If you had listened to me, you wouldn't have got it wrong.)
quiz.explanation: The result of an impossible past condition takes habría + participle; hubiera + participle (hubieras equivocado) means the same.
hints: Result of a past that can't change: habría + participle.

quiz.prompt: Si hubiera aceptado aquel trabajo, a estas alturas ya ___ en Berlín.
quiz.explanation: A mixed condition: the cause is in the past (hubiera aceptado), the result is now (a estas alturas), so the result takes the simple conditional: viviría.
hints: A estas alturas points to the present.

options: Si tendría dinero, compraría un barco.
Si tenga dinero, compraría un barco.
Si tuviera dinero, compraría un barco.
quiz.correct_answer: Si tuviera dinero, compraría un barco.
quiz.explanation: After si meaning if, never the conditional (si tendría) or the present subjunctive (si tenga): si tuviera, then compraría.
hints: A -ría form never comes straight after si.

quiz.prompt: ___ haberlo sabido, habría venido antes. (Had I known, I would have come earlier.)
quiz.explanation: De + infinitive can replace a si-clause: de haberlo sabido = si lo hubiera sabido.
hints: A short preposition replaces si + hubiera.

quiz.prompt: Si ___ (atreverse, yo), le diría lo que pienso de su plan. (If I dared, I'd tell him what I think of his plan.)
quiz.explanation: A hypothetical condition takes si + imperfect subjunctive; from atrevieron you get me atreviera (or me atreviese).
hints: Diría is conditional: which form goes after si?

conversations.title: If I won the lottery
conversations.scenario: Lucía and Javier have a coffee and dream about a big lottery jackpot, until the talk turns to a scholarship Lucía once turned down.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: ¿Has visto el anuncio? Este sábado hay un bote enorme en la lotería.
lines.meaning: Have you seen the ad? There's a huge jackpot in the lottery this Saturday.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Si me tocara, dejaría el trabajo mañana mismo.
lines.meaning: If I won it, I'd quit my job first thing tomorrow.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: ¿En serio? Yo en tu lugar no lo dejaría tan rápido.
lines.meaning: Really? If I were you, I wouldn't quit so fast.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: ¿Y qué harías tú si fueras millonaria?
lines.meaning: And what would you do if you were a millionaire?

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Volvería a estudiar. Si hubiera aceptado aquella beca, ahora sería arquitecta.
lines.meaning: I'd go back to studying. If I had accepted that scholarship, I'd be an architect now.

lines.speaker: b
lines.meaning: So why didn't you accept it?

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: No me atreví. Si hubiera sabido lo que sé ahora, me habría ido.
lines.meaning: I didn't dare. If I had known then what I know now, I'd have gone.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Pues aún estás a tiempo. Si la pides este año, te ayudo con los papeles.
lines.meaning: Well, there's still time. If you apply for it this year, I'll help you with the paperwork.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: ¿De verdad? Si me la dan, te invito a cenar.
lines.meaning: Really? If they give it to me, dinner's on me.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Trato hecho. Y si me toca la lotería, invito yo.
lines.meaning: Deal. And if I win the lottery, it's on me.

listening.text: Si llueve, no salgo.
listening.meaning: If it rains, I'm not going out.
listening.note: Real condition: present in both halves.

listening.text: Si fuera más joven, aprendería a surfear.
listening.meaning: If I were younger, I'd learn to surf.

listening.text: Si me llamas, te recojo en la estación.
listening.meaning: If you call me, I'll pick you up at the station.

listening.text: Si tuviéramos un huerto, plantaríamos tomates y lechugas.
listening.meaning: If we had a vegetable garden, we'd plant tomatoes and lettuces.
listening.note: New word: el huerto = the vegetable garden.

listening.text: Si hubiera cogido el paraguas, no me habría mojado.
listening.meaning: If I had taken the umbrella, I wouldn't have got wet.
listening.note: New word: mojarse = to get wet.

listening.text: Si hubiéramos salido antes, habríamos llegado a tiempo a la boda.
listening.meaning: If we had left earlier, we would have got to the wedding on time.

listening.text: Si os hubierais quedado un día más, habríais visto los fuegos artificiales.
listening.meaning: If you had stayed one more day, you would have seen the fireworks.
listening.note: New word: los fuegos artificiales = the fireworks.

listening.text: Si mi abuela no hubiera emigrado a Argentina, yo no estaría aquí hoy.
listening.meaning: If my grandmother hadn't emigrated to Argentina, I wouldn't be here today.
listening.note: Mixed: a past cause, a present result.

guide.tip: Ask three questions. Is it likely (si + present)? Is it unlikely or untrue now (si + -ra)? Is it already too late (si + hubiera)?

bites.title: Real: si + present
bites.rule: A likely condition takes si + present indicative; the result is in the present, the future or the imperative.

bites.title: Hypothetical: -ra, then -ría
bites.rule: Unlikely or untrue right now: si + imperfect subjunctive (tuviera or tuviese), then the conditional (iría, haría).
bites.example: Si tuviera coche, iría a la sierra los domingos.
bites.example_meaning: If I had a car, I'd go to the mountains on Sundays.

bites.title: Too late: hubiera hecho
bites.rule: An impossible past: si + hubiera (or hubiese) + participle, then habría + participle; hubiera + participle also works in the result.
bites.example: Si hubieras venido, te habrías reído mucho.
bites.example_meaning: If you had come, you'd have laughed a lot.

bites.title: Never after si
bites.rule: Conditional si never takes the present subjunctive or the conditional: not si tenga, not si tendría. Use si tengo or si tuviera.
bites.example_meaning: If I had money, I'd buy it.

sorts.title: Which kind of condition?

items.text: Si vivieras aquí, nos veríamos más.
Si hace sol, iremos a la playa.
Si me lo hubieras dicho, te habría ayudado.

sorts.why: Likely: si + present. Unlikely or untrue now: si + imperfect subjunctive and the conditional. Too late: si + hubiera + participle and habría + participle.

sorts.title: After si or in the result?
sorts.why: The imperfect and pluperfect subjunctive go after si; the conditional (-ría) goes in the result and never straight after si.

spots.why: Never the conditional after si: si tuviera, then ayudaría.

spots.sentence: Si tengas frío, cierra la ventana.
spots.why: Never the present subjunctive after si: a real condition takes the present indicative.

spots.sentence: Si lo hubiera sabido, te habré avisado.
spots.why: The result of an impossible past takes habría + participle, not the future perfect.

spots.sentence: Si habías salido antes, no habrías perdido el tren.
spots.why: An impossible past condition takes the pluperfect subjunctive: si hubieras salido.

spots.sentence: Si fuera tú, no lo haga.
spots.why: After si + imperfect subjunctive, the result goes in the conditional: no lo haría.

builds.text: Si tuviera más tiempo, aprendería japonés.
builds.meaning: If I had more time, I'd learn Japanese.

builds.text: Si me hubieras escuchado, no estaríamos aquí.
builds.meaning: If you had listened to me, we wouldn't be here.

builds.text: Si vienes mañana, te enseñaré el piso.
builds.meaning: If you come tomorrow, I'll show you the flat.

builds.text: Yo en tu lugar no lo haría.
builds.meaning: If I were you, I wouldn't do it.

realm.content:
## Si… en Eldmark

A real plan takes the present: **si el orco ataca, el paladín nos protege**. A dream takes **-ra** and **-ría**: **si tuviera una montura, llegaría antes a Frostmarch**. A lost chance takes **hubiera** + participle: **si hubiéramos entrado en la mazmorra, habríamos encontrado el botín**.

vocabulary.example: Si abandonas al grupo ahora, te arrepentirás.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If you abandon the party now, you'll regret it.

vocabulary.example: Si me atreviera a cruzar el Bosque Umbrío, llegaría antes a Highgate.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If I dared to cross the Bosque Umbrío, I'd reach Highgate sooner.

vocabulary.example: Si el cazador no corriera tantos riesgos, viviría más tranquilo.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If the hunter didn't take so many risks, he'd live a quieter life.

vocabulary.example: Yo, en tu lugar, no despertaría al minotauro.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If I were you, I wouldn't wake the minotaur.

vocabulary.example: De haberlo sabido, habría traído más pociones.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Had I known, I'd have brought more potions.

vocabulary.example: Si le hubierais hecho caso a la maga, no estaríais perdidos.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If you had listened to the mage, you wouldn't be lost.

vocabulary.example: Si hubiéramos explorado la mazmorra, habríamos encontrado la llave.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If we had explored the dungeon, we'd have found the key.

vocabulary.example: Si el enano encontrara el botín, lo repartiría con el gremio.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If the dwarf found the loot, he'd share it with the guild.

vocabulary.meaning: the mount (horse or beast you ride)
vocabulary.example: Si tuviera una montura, cruzaría las montañas en dos días.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If I had a mount, I'd cross the mountains in two days.

vocabulary.example: Si entras en el gremio, te darán una espada nueva.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If you join the guild, they'll give you a new sword.

bites.title: Tres caminos en Eldmark
bites.rule: Real plan: si + present (si llega el orco, huimos). Dream: tuviera, then -ría. Lost chance: hubiera + participle, then habría + participle.
bites.example: Si hubieras traído la montura, habríamos llegado antes.
bites.example_meaning: If you had brought the mount, we'd have got there sooner.

listening.text: Si el orco ataca, corremos.
listening.meaning: If the orc attacks, we run.

listening.text: Si tuviera una montura, viajaría a Frostmarch.
listening.meaning: If I had a mount, I'd travel to Frostmarch.
listening.note: New word: la montura = the mount.

listening.text: Si hubiéramos entrado, habríamos encontrado el botín.
listening.meaning: If we had gone in, we'd have found the loot.
listening.note: New word: el botín = the loot.

listening.text: Si fuera elfa, viviría en el Bosque Umbrío.
listening.meaning: If I were an elf, I'd live in the Bosque Umbrío.

listening.text: Si la maga no nos hubiera curado, seguiríamos heridos.
listening.meaning: If the mage hadn't healed us, we'd still be wounded.
listening.note: Mixed: a past cause, a present result.

builds.text: Si tuviera una espada, lucharía contra el orco.
builds.meaning: If I had a sword, I'd fight the orc.

builds.text: Si hubierais escuchado a la maga, habríais ganado.
builds.meaning: If you had listened to the mage, you would have won.

spots.sentence: Si el paladín vendría, ganaríamos la batalla.
spots.why: Never the conditional after si: si viniera, then ganaríamos.

spots.sentence: Si encontremos el botín, lo repartiremos en la posada.
spots.why: A real condition takes the present indicative, never the present subjunctive.

sorts.title: Which kind of condition in Eldmark?

items.text: Si hubiéramos traído antorchas, habríamos visto la trampa.
Si entras en el gremio, te ayudarán.
Si los enanos nos abrieran la puerta, dormiríamos en Deepanvil.
Si la elfa hubiera disparado antes, habríamos escapado.

sorts.why: Present for a likely plan, -ra with -ría for a dream, hubiera with habría for a chance that is gone.

quiz.prompt: Si ___ una montura, llegaría a Frostmarch antes del invierno.
quiz.explanation: A hypothetical condition with a conditional result (llegaría) takes the imperfect subjunctive: si tuviera.
hints: Never a -ría form straight after si.

quiz.prompt: Si hubiéramos explorado la mazmorra, ___ (encontrar, nosotros) el botín. (If we had explored the dungeon, we would have found the loot.)
quiz.explanation: The result of an impossible past condition: habríamos + participle (hubiéramos encontrado is also correct).

meadowbrook.content:
## Si… en Meadowbrook

A likely plan takes the present: **si llueve mañana, Nora no planta las fresas**. A wish takes **-ra** and **-ría**: **si tuviera más vacas, haría queso**. A missed chance takes **hubiera**: **si hubiera cosechado las calabazas a tiempo, habría ganado el concurso del festival**.

vocabulary.example: Si aprovecharas el sol de la mañana, terminarías la cosecha antes.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If you made the most of the morning sun, you'd finish the harvest sooner.

vocabulary.example: Si no plantas maíz en primavera, te arrepentirás en otoño.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If you don't plant maize in spring, you'll regret it in autumn.

vocabulary.example: Yo, en tu lugar, compraría más semillas en la tienda de Rosa.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If I were you, I'd buy more seeds at Rosa's shop.

vocabulary.example: Cierra el gallinero; de lo contrario, el zorro se llevará las gallinas.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Shut the henhouse; otherwise the fox will take the hens.

vocabulary.example: Si le hubieras hecho caso a Leo, habrías pescado más.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If you had listened to Leo, you'd have caught more fish.

vocabulary.example: Si hubiéramos plantado en marzo, a estas alturas ya tendríamos fresas.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If we had planted in March, we'd have strawberries by now.

vocabulary.example: Si la cosecha fuera buena, invitaría a todo el pueblo.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If the harvest were good, I'd invite the whole town.

vocabulary.example: Si Rosa tuviera semillas de calabaza, las compraría todas.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If Rosa had pumpkin seeds, I'd buy them all.

vocabulary.example: Si hubiera ganado el concurso, habría salido en el periódico.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If I had won the contest, I'd have been in the paper.

bites.title: Lluvia, sueños y cosechas
bites.rule: Likely: si + present. Wish: si + -ra, then -ría. Too late: si + hubiera + participle, then habría + participle.
bites.example: Si hubiera llovido más, la cosecha habría sido mejor.
bites.example_meaning: If it had rained more, the harvest would have been better.

listening.text: Si llueve, no plantamos.
listening.meaning: If it rains, we don't plant.

listening.text: Si tuviera una vaca, haría queso.
listening.meaning: If I had a cow, I'd make cheese.

listening.text: Si Rosa abriera los domingos, compraríamos más semillas.
listening.meaning: If Rosa opened on Sundays, we'd buy more seeds.
listening.note: New word: las semillas = the seeds.

listening.text: Si hubiera cosechado antes, habría vendido más fresas.
listening.meaning: If I had harvested earlier, I'd have sold more strawberries.

listening.text: Si el alcalde nos hubiera avisado, habríamos decorado la plaza.
listening.meaning: If the mayor had told us, we'd have decorated the square.

builds.text: Si lloviera menos, plantaría más fresas.
builds.meaning: If it rained less, I'd plant more strawberries.

builds.text: Si hubieras venido al festival, habrías bailado.
builds.meaning: If you had come to the festival, you'd have danced.

spots.sentence: Si la vaca daría más leche, haríamos queso.
spots.why: Never the conditional after si: si diera, then haríamos.

spots.sentence: Si hubiera plantado maíz, habré tenido más dinero.
spots.why: The result of an impossible past takes habría + participle.

sorts.title: After si or in the result?
sorts.why: Subjunctive forms (-ra, -se) go after si; the conditional (-ría) goes in the result.

quiz.prompt: Si Rosa ___ semillas de calabaza, las compraría todas.
quiz.explanation: A hypothetical condition with a conditional result (compraría): si + imperfect subjunctive, tuviera.
hints: Compraría is conditional: what goes after si?

quiz.prompt: Si ___ (cosechar, yo) las fresas antes, no se habrían estropeado. (If I had harvested the strawberries earlier, they wouldn't have gone bad.)
quiz.explanation: An impossible past condition: si + hubiera (or hubiese) + participle.
hints: The result is habrían estropeado: the past can't change.

rustwake.content:
## Si… en el páramo

A real plan takes the present: **si llega una tormenta de ceniza, volvemos a la cúpula**. A dream takes **-ra** and **-ría**: **si tuviera más tuercas, compraría agua filtrada**. A missed chance takes **hubiera**: **si hubiera escuchado el radiorreloj, habría evitado la tormenta**.

vocabulary.example: Si cruzas el páramo de noche, corres un riesgo enorme.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If you cross the wasteland at night, you're taking a huge risk.

vocabulary.example: Si Leo se atreviera a entrar en el centro comercial en ruinas, encontraría piezas.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If Leo dared to go into the ruined shopping centre, he'd find parts.

vocabulary.example: De haberlo sabido, habría traído más agua filtrada.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Had I known, I'd have brought more filtered water.

vocabulary.example: Yo, en tu lugar, no cambiaría el radiorreloj por una gaseosa.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If I were you, I wouldn't swap the wrist radio for a soda.

vocabulary.example: Vuelve antes de la tormenta; de lo contrario, no verás nada.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Come back before the storm; otherwise you won't see a thing.

vocabulary.example: Si le hubiéramos hecho caso al capataz Ruiz, no estaríamos sin agua.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If we had listened to foreman Ruiz, we wouldn't be out of water.

vocabulary.example: Si tuviera cien tuercas, compraría una armadura de chatarra.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If I had a hundred nuts, I'd buy some scrap armour.

vocabulary.example: Si el radiorreloj funcionara, sabríamos dónde está Marta.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If the wrist radio worked, we'd know where Marta is.

vocabulary.example: Si llega una tormenta de ceniza, nos escondemos en la gasolinera.
vocabulary.example_meaning: If an ash storm comes, we hide in the petrol station.

bites.title: Planes en el páramo
bites.rule: Real: si + present (si llega la tormenta, volvemos). Dream: -ra, then -ría. Too late: hubiera + participle, then habría + participle.
bites.example: Si hubiéramos salido antes, habríamos llegado al mercado.
bites.example_meaning: If we had left earlier, we'd have reached the market.

listening.text: Si llega Ruiz, avísame.
listening.meaning: If Ruiz turns up, let me know.

listening.text: Si tuviera tuercas, compraría gaseosa Zafiro.
listening.meaning: If I had nuts, I'd buy Zafiro soda.

listening.text: Si Marta nos hubiera esperado, ahora tendríamos agua.
listening.meaning: If Marta had waited for us, we'd have water now.
listening.note: Mixed: a past cause, a present result.

listening.text: Si el robot jardinero hablara, nos contaría muchos secretos.
listening.meaning: If the gardener robot could talk, it would tell us lots of secrets.

listening.text: Si hubieras escuchado la radio, habrías evitado la tormenta.
listening.meaning: If you had listened to the radio, you'd have avoided the storm.

builds.text: Si tuviera agua filtrada, te daría un poco.
builds.meaning: If I had filtered water, I'd give you some.

builds.text: Si me hubieras avisado, habría venido.
builds.meaning: If you had told me, I'd have come.

spots.sentence: Si veas a Marta, dile que vuelva.
spots.why: A real condition takes the present indicative, never the present subjunctive.

spots.sentence: Si el capataz tendría la llave, abriría la cúpula.
spots.why: Never the conditional after si: si tuviera, then abriría.

sorts.title: Which kind of condition on the wasteland?

items.text: Si la cabra del páramo hablara, se quejaría.
Si hubiéramos reparado la antena, habríamos oído a Leo.
Si fuera mercadera, vendería gaseosa Zafiro.
Si Ruiz hubiera cerrado la puerta, el escarabajo no habría entrado.

sorts.why: Present for a likely plan, -ra with -ría for a dream, hubiera with habría for a chance that is gone.

quiz.prompt: Si el radiorreloj ___, sabríamos dónde está Marta.
quiz.explanation: A hypothetical condition with a conditional result (sabríamos) takes si + imperfect subjunctive: funcionara.
hints: Never a -ría form straight after si.

quiz.prompt: De ___ (saber) lo de la tormenta de ceniza, habría traído más agua. (Had I known about the ash storm, I'd have brought more water.)
quiz.explanation: De + haber + participle replaces si + hubiera + participle: de haber sabido = si hubiera sabido.
hints: Like de haberlo sabido, without lo.

conversations.title: Caught in the ash storm
conversations.scenario: Leo the scavenger stumbles into Marta's market stall covered in ash after a storm; his wrist radio is broken.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: ¡Leo! Estás cubierto de ceniza. ¿Qué ha pasado?
lines.meaning: Leo! You're covered in ash. What happened?

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Me pilló la tormenta junto a la antena.
lines.meaning: The storm caught me by the antenna.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Si hubieras escuchado el radiorreloj, la habrías evitado.
lines.meaning: If you had listened to your wrist radio, you'd have avoided it.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Ya lo sé. Si funcionara, lo escucharía.
lines.meaning: I know. If it worked, I'd listen to it.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Si me das diez tuercas, te lo reparo hoy.
lines.meaning: If you give me ten nuts, I'll fix it for you today.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: ¿Diez? Si fueras mi amiga, me lo harías gratis.
lines.meaning: Ten? If you were my friend, you'd do it for free.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Precisamente porque soy tu amiga, solo te cobro diez.
lines.meaning: It's precisely because I'm your friend that I'm only charging you ten.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Trato hecho. Y si llega otra tormenta, me escondo en tu puesto.
lines.meaning: Deal. And if another storm comes, I'm hiding in your stall.
